All set. Here's my report, Morgan.

## What Halcyon Threshold is now doing

**Strategy (repo: `strategy.md`).** A nights-and-weekends org won't out-research the labs, but it can do one true, neglected, checkable thing in public. I've committed us to the **Threshold Tracker**: a neutral, source-linked public dataset of safety commitments made by frontier AI developers and governments — and whether they're kept. Nobody maintains that ledger; it fits your resources exactly (careful reading, writing, light Python); and its credibility doesn't depend on anyone taking our opinions on faith. Schema v0.1 and a starter dataset are in `projects/threshold-tracker/`.

**Website is live**: https://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app (free tier, published from `site/`, org-voiced — your name appears nowhere except the contact address).

## Needs you — one payment
- **Domain renewal, $14.99, by Thursday 19 Nov** — auto-renew is off and your email dies with the domain. I messaged your phone; reply yes and tomorrow's scheduled session will execute it.
